description: Track D — Operator/Attendant view. Segmented capacity bar (green/yellow/orange/red with text+legend), side-by-side Check IN/OUT with Camera/Manual Entry tabs, scan->prefilled manual entry, Plate Region dropdown removed, host dropdown + 'Other', inline Make/Model/Year, sequential slot picker with override, checkout confirmation screen, checkout plate autocomplete sorted longest-stay-first with a virtual keyboard, and a collapsible/sortable/searchable Recent Activity with per-row quick checkout. Requirements AC-4.1..4.5; design section 4. Appends session.authorized_by to migration 018. Depends on FEAT-003 for the migration file existing (append if present, create if not). Run after FEAT-003.
steps: Migration 018_epd_feedback.sql: add session.authorized_by jsonb (nullable; shaped { unit: string } | { name: string, phone: string }; always NULL for a pass redemption). Create the file if FEAT-003 has not yet; otherwise append.

API — GET /v1/occupancy (routes/slots.ts): add top-level issuedPending, over10, over12 computed in the SAME handler, each reusing the TEXTUALLY IDENTICAL site predicate `($1::text is null or st.code = $1) and ($2::uuid is null or st.id = $2)` with args `[q.site ?? null, ctx.siteId]`. issuedPending = count of pass p join site st where p.status='active' and p.expires_at > now() and <predicate>. over10/over12 = count of session s join site st where s.status='open' and <predicate> and s.in_at < now() - interval '10 hours' (resp. '12 hours'). Keep totals. N (for the bar) = totals.free + totals.occupied + totals.reserved.

Web — pure helper capacityBar({ n, occupied, issuedPending, over10, over12 }) in apps/web/src/attendant-flow.ts returning { green, yellow, free, pendingSurplus, over10, over12 } with: green=min(occupied,n); yellow=max(0,min(n-green,issuedPending)); free=n-green-yellow; pendingSurplus=max(0,issuedPending-(n-green)); over10/over12 passed through (subsets of occupied). Unit-test it (e.g. n=10,occupied=7,issuedPending=5,over10=3,over12=1 -> green=7,yellow=3,free=0,pendingSurplus=2,over10=3,over12=1) in apps/web/test/attendant-flow.test.ts.

API — GET /v1/sessions (routes/sessions.ts): add sort: z.enum(['in_at_desc','in_at_asc','unit']).default('in_at_desc') and q (string <=40). resolved_unit = coalesce(pu.code, authorized_by->>'unit') via left join pass p on p.session_id=s.id left join unit pu on pu.id=p.unit_id. in_at_desc -> order by s.in_at desc; in_at_asc -> order by s.in_at asc; unit -> order by resolved_unit asc nulls last, s.in_at desc. q matches v.plate_norm prefix OR resolved_unit prefix only (never authorizer name). Pin in an API test (walk-in 'Other' excluded from unit search + sorted last; unit-hosted found by unit-code prefix).

API — POST /v1/sessions (routes/sessions.ts) + checkIn (services/sessions.ts): add optional host: { unit: string } | { name: string, phone: string } (exactly one shape; phone E.164; name <=80). Validation failure -> 400 host_invalid; unknown unit code -> 404 unit_not_found. Thread via CheckInInput.authorizedBy: checkIn's insert into session gains authorized_by ($N::jsonb bound to JSON.stringify(input.authorizedBy) or null) and the normalized value is added to the check_in session_event payload. RedeemInput inherits the optional field but redeemPass NEVER sets it (authorized_by stays NULL for redemptions). Add vehicle.year through CheckInInput/checkIn if not already carried (verify in services/sessions.ts; the insert already references year on vehicle).

API — GET /v1/units (routes/people.ts): add a `site` query param; when present, return units where s.code = $site OR u.site_id IS NULL (via the existing left join site s on s.id = u.site_id), ordered by u.code, capped at ~500. Keep the existing ctx.siteId behavior. Feeds the Host dropdown.

API — ensure suggestSlot (services/sessions.ts) considers only status='available' slots (it already filters status='available'; confirm reserved/out_of_service are excluded; keep order by zone.sort, slot.code for sequential pick).

Web — Attendant.tsx capacity bar: a labeled region (role='img' with aria-label summarizing 'X of N occupied, Y pending, Z over 10h, W over 12h') + a visible legend with text labels and distinct patterns (not hue alone) + a numeric caption. Over-10/over-12 render as overlay stripe + icon + count on the rightmost GREEN segments (RED precedence over ORANGE), never extra length. N=0 -> empty bar + 'no assignable slots'. CSS grid of N segments, logical props, responsive to 390px.

Web — Attendant.tsx check-in: side-by-side Check IN / Check OUT buttons above the bar. Relabel the Camera/Keypad toggle as role=tablist tabs 'Camera' / 'Manual Entry' (aria-selected), defaulting to Camera even when ai_mode==='off' (Camera tab then shows the QR scanner + an AI-off note; Manual Entry works). A successful plate read or hinted-pass scan navigates to the confirm (Manual Entry) screen prefilled. REMOVE the att.region <select> from the manual-entry branch (pure UI deletion; keypad charset is the fixed KEY_ROWS constant; checkIn already defaults region to tenant.plate_regions[0]).

Web — confirm screen: Host control = a type-ahead combobox over GET /v1/units?site=CODE submitting the unit code (-> host:{unit}), plus an 'Other' option revealing required name + phone (E.164) submitting host:{name,phone}. For a pass redemption the Host is fixed read-only to the pass's unit. Make/Model/Year inline (.row of three; add optional Year numeric 1900..currentYear+1). Assigned Slot = a picker button showing the suggested slot (GET /v1/slots/suggest) that opens a list of free slots from GET /v1/slots?site=&status=available so the attendant can pick a different one.

Web — check-out: add Camera / Manual Entry tabs (default Camera) matching check-in. The post-match screen gets an explicit 'Confirm this vehicle is leaving' heading (relabel the primary action). Manual Entry plate field becomes an autocomplete combobox (native input role='combobox' aria-autocomplete='list' aria-controls + <ul role='listbox'>) over GET /v1/sessions?site=&status=open&sort=in_at_asc (longest stay first). Each option's VISIBLE label is plate + slot + duration; the session ticket is the option's INTERNAL value only (never shown); on select call find({ ticket }). Virtual keyboard: reuse the Keypad component in a bottom sheet that animates up (transform: translateY(100%)->0), keyboard-operable + dismissible (Esc + close button), feeds the combobox input; listbox arrow-key navigation with aria-activedescendant. Empty open set -> 'no vehicles currently parked'.

Web — Recent Activity: wrap in the same <Collapsible> as the resident sections, closed by default. Add a sort <select> (check-in time -> in_at_desc | host unit -> unit) and a search <input> (plate or unit) driving GET /v1/sessions. Each open-session row gets a 'Check out' button navigating to /a/checkout with the session ticket in router state (CheckOut runs find({ ticket }) on mount); closed rows show the fee, no action.

Add all new UI strings (tabs, host/other labels, year, slot picker, checkout confirmation, autocomplete empty/label, virtual keyboard labels, recent-activity sort/search/quick-checkout, capacity-bar legend/aria) to ALL seven web locale catalogs with matching placeholders. New CSS uses logical properties only (translateX/translateY are allowed).
acceptance_criteria: The capacity bar is segmented 1..N (N=free+occupied+reserved) with green=occupied, yellow=issuedPending, orange>10h, red>12h overlays; color is never the only signal (legend + patterns + aria summary); the capacityBar helper unit test passes.
Check IN and Check OUT are side-by-side; both offer Camera/Manual Entry tabs (default Camera); a successful scan lands on a prefilled Manual Entry confirm; the Plate Region dropdown is gone.

Check-in fields: Plate required; optional inline Make/Model/Year; Host = unit dropdown + 'Other' (name+phone captured and persisted to session.authorized_by + check_in event); Assigned Slot auto-picks sequentially and is overridable via a picker.

Check-out shows Camera/Manual Entry tabs and a 'vehicle is leaving' confirmation; Manual Entry is a plate autocomplete sorted longest-stay-first (ticket never shown) with a bottom-sheet virtual keyboard.
Recent Activity is collapsible (closed by default), sortable (check-in time | host unit) and searchable (plate | unit, never authorizer name — API test pins this), with a per-open-row quick checkout.

GET /v1/occupancy issuedPending/over10/over12 reuse the shipped site predicate (no cross-site leak) and GET /v1/sessions sort/search work server-side; the full gate passes and all new strings exist in every catalog.
findings:
Done. Full gate green (core build, typecheck, pnpm test [api 115 + web 121], web check:css).

MIGRATION 018: appended `session.authorized_by jsonb` (nullable; { unit } | { name, phone }; always NULL for a pass redemption). FEAT-003's columns (avatar_key, notify_guest_events, pass.created_by) were already present and untouched.

API:
- GET /v1/occupancy (routes/slots.ts): added top-level issuedPending/over10/over12, each reusing the IDENTICAL site predicate + args [q.site ?? null, ctx.siteId]. over10/over12 compare s.in_at against app.now() bound as a $N::timestamptz param (NOT DB now()) so the injected test clock drives them — this is the only deviation from the design's literal `now()`, chosen because sessions insert in_at from app.now() and tests inject the clock; production behaviour is unchanged (app.now() === wall clock in prod). N for the bar = totals.free+occupied+reserved.
- GET /v1/sessions: added sort enum (in_at_desc default | in_at_asc | unit) and q (<=40). resolved_unit = coalesce(pu.code, authorized_by->>'unit') via left join pass p on p.session_id=s.id left join unit pu on pu.id=p.unit_id. q matches plate_norm prefix OR resolved_unit prefix ONLY (never authorizer name). sort=unit => order by resolved_unit asc nulls last, s.in_at desc. Response rows now also carry `unit` (resolved_unit) for the UI.
- POST /v1/sessions: added optional `host` validated IN THE HANDLER (body schema takes host:z.unknown() then Host.safeParse) so a bad shape is a precise 400 host_invalid, not validation_failed; unknown unit => 404 unit_not_found. Threaded via CheckInInput.authorizedBy into the session insert (authorized_by $N::jsonb) and the check_in session_event payload. redeemPass NEVER sets it (authorized_by stays NULL for redemptions; RedeemInput inherits the optional field but the redeem route doesn't accept host). vehicle.year was already carried end-to-end.
- GET /v1/units: added `site` query param => units where s.code=$site OR u.site_id IS NULL (left join site), ordered by u.code, capped 500; ctx.siteId scope preserved. Feeds the Host dropdown.
- suggestSlot already filters status='available' (excludes reserved/out_of_service); confirmed, unchanged.

WEB:
- attendant-flow.ts: added pure capacityBar({n,occupied,issuedPending,over10,over12}) => {green,yellow,free,pendingSurplus,over10,over12}; unit-tested (incl. n=10,occ=7,pending=5,over10=3,over12=1 => green7/yellow3/free0/surplus2). Added vehicle.year to FlowState.
- Attendant.tsx: local Collapsible + Tabs primitives (no shared Collapsible exists yet — FEAT-003's resident UI isn't built). CapacityBar (role=img + aria summary + legend with patterns-not-hue + numeric caption + pendingSurplus caption; N=0 => empty bar + 'no assignable slots'; over10/over12 overlay the rightmost GREEN segments, RED over ORANGE). AttendantHome: side-by-side Check IN/OUT, capacity bar, collapsible (closed-by-default) Recent Activity with sort select (check-in time|host unit) + search input + per-open-row Check out button navigating to /a/checkout with the ticket in router state. CheckIn: Camera/Manual Entry role=tablist tabs defaulting to Camera even when ai_mode==='off' (Camera then shows the QR scanner + AI-off note), Plate Region <select> REMOVED. Confirm: HostControl (type-ahead combobox over /v1/units?site= + 'Other' name+phone; read-only fixed to the pass unit on a redemption), inline Make/Model/Year (optional numeric 1900..year+1), SlotPicker button over /v1/slots?site=&status=available. CheckOut: Camera/Manual Entry tabs; confirmation gets 'Confirm this vehicle is leaving' heading + relabeled primary action; Manual Entry = PlateAutocomplete combobox (role=combobox aria-autocomplete=list aria-controls + ul role=listbox, arrow keys + aria-activedescendant) over /v1/sessions?status=open&sort=in_at_asc, VISIBLE label plate+slot+duration, ticket internal-only, select => find({ticket}); bottom-sheet keyboard reuses Keypad, animates translateY(100%->0), Esc + close button. Empty open set => 'no vehicles currently parked'.
- 29 new att.* strings added to ALL SEVEN catalogs (en, es-MX, es-ES, pt-BR, fr, de, ar) with identical ICU placeholders; en-XA untouched (build-generated). New CSS in styles.css uses logical properties only (translateY in the sheet keyframe is allowed).

PRESERVED: HMAC OPP2 pass token (server re-reads pass, never trusts client fields) and the overstay policy wording.

TEST-ADJUSTMENT (not a weakening): attendant-screen.test.tsx's rejected-pass case asserted no element with role=status; with Camera now default even when AI is off, LiveCamera renders its own unrelated 'camera unavailable' role=status note in jsdom. Narrowed the assertion to 'no ACCEPTED-pass banner (att.passFor text)', which is the test's real intent — coverage unchanged.

NEW TESTS: 4 API cases (walk-in host persisted to session+check_in event; 404 unit_not_found + 400 host_invalid; search by plate/unit prefix but never authorizer name + 'Other' sorts last under sort=unit; occupancy issuedPending/over10/over12). 4 capacityBar unit cases.

For later steps (FEAT-005): session rows from GET /v1/sessions now expose `unit`; GET /v1/occupancy exposes issuedPending/over10/over12. ctx.unitVerified is NOT added here (FEAT-005 owns it).
